prose: Short note from feed metadata only: Reuters reports that Marvell has agreed to acquire optical-components maker Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal aimed at rivaling Broadcom - and that Nvidia invested $2 billion in each company in 2026. The source is error-cached, so deal terms beyond the headline are unverified. Either way, it is the week's largest single bet on the optical layer of AI infrastructure.
